basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 24-year-old digital artist based in Portland, Oregon. I've been a Redditor since my late teens, mainly lurking around fanfiction and LEGO subreddits. Huge fan of both J2i fanfic and BricksByMind communities where I contribute artwork and engage in discussions. When I'm not online, I'm either sketching new designs or playing with my custom LEGO builds. I work as a freelance illustrator, which gives me the flexibility to manage my own hours, though I'm typically active online during late evenings. Currently single, but always open to meeting new people!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a BFA in Digital Media Arts, which laid the foundation for my love of storytelling and visual design. Over the years, I've honed my skills through online courses and tutorials, particularly in digital painting and 3D modeling. My passion for LEGO and fanfiction communities has also driven me to expand my creativity in unique ways.
